description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Thales Defense & Security, Inc. is seeking an Associate Embedded Software Engineer for its product development team in Germantown, Maryland. The role develops software for radio hardware and integrates embedded systems, networking, and distributed software into communication products.
Associate Embedded Software Engineer developing embedded software that programs radio hardware for intelligent communication systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop new Software. Write code that turns advanced radio hardware into intelligent, programmable communication systems
• Solve real-world technical challenges. Our cross-functional software teams integrate embedded systems, networking, and distributed software
• Collaborate with engineers. See your code move beyond a screen and become integrated within technology that connects people in environments where communications matter most

Requirements:
• U.S. Citizenship required
• Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information
• BSEE/BSCE/BSCS or MSEE
• Strong oral and written communication skills are critical to success
• Software development skills to augment high-performing teams
• Linux environment on ARM processors
• Bare-metal software systems on micro-controllers
• Heavy use of C/C++, Python
• Integration of emerging AI technologies
• Structured development processes (Test Driven Development, peer reviews, unit testing, configuration management, defect tracking)
• Agile methodologies and techniques
• Strong collaboration skills
• Networking skills
• Ability to work independently while thriving in a fast‑paced, multidisciplinary team environment
